verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server whose tools let AI agents interact with the Stripe API and search Stripe documentation, and Financial Connections is part of that API. The evidence never shows the server exposing Financial Connections objects such as accounts, balances, ownership or transactions, so coverage of this product specifically is unproven. Missing for 10: documented Financial Connections-specific MCP tools, setup/auth details for agents using Financial Connections data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API and search Stripe’s knowledge base, including documentation and support articles.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
